posts.body:
Im using a character builder and the format is
FRAME: 1-2-3-4-5-6-7-8 and i use character frames plugin.
BUT! The idle frame is 2, which makes it look weird when they stand still.
How to fix?

It would be beneficial if you linked the exact plugin you are using for clarity.
The idle in RPG Maker by default is frame 2. This is because it's kind of a janky side effect of having only 3 frames. Frame one and 3 (left and right frames) are steps while the middle frame would be mid way between the steps,which in only 3 frames would look like them just...standing.
Most plugins that allow for higher frame rate characters are aware of this fact and usually include a section to define the idle sprite. Since you are using higher frame rates, there is unlikely to be a janky mid point in the stepping animation that happens to look like the character just standing. So you'd want to bring your own idle animation.
